title: Product Manager
description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.

This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

  • Partner Engagement & Insight:

    • Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

    • Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

    • Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve

  • Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace, or dealer-facing products

  • Familiarity with gamification or engagement loop design in a B2B context

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding.

Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals.

🎯 Your mission

You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product.

Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems.

You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Responsibilities

Build AI-powered product features

  • Design and ship AI features used directly by lawyers

  • Be at the bleeing edge of the agentic stack: memory, sandboxes, code mode, lots of tools, subagents…

  • Turn prototypes and experiments into production-ready feature

Work with complex data

  • Extract, structure and reason over large volumes of unstructured legal documents

  • Build robust data and document-processing pipelines

  • Experiment with different models and approaches to improve accuracy and reliability

Make AI work in production

  • Evaluate and improve agent outcomes through testing, evals and iteration

  • Optimize systems for quality, latency and cost

  • Build the backend services and infrastructure needed to run AI reliably at scale

Shape the product

  • Work directly with the founders and users to understand real-world problems

  • Move quickly from problem → experiment → production (think days, not weeks)

  • Take ownership of your projects from exploration to deployment

🤩 This role is for you if

We're looking for a strong software or AI engineer with 2+ years of experience who wants to build real-world AI products at the forefront of the agentic stack.

You like working close to founders and users, making pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping software that actually runs in production.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong software engineering foundation, ideally with Typescript and experience shipping production systems

  • Have experience with agents and/or evals and frameworks like Mastra, Eve, Pydantic, Langchain, etc…

  • Can take an AI problem from experimentation to production

  • Enjoy solving problems with no clear solution

  • Have a strong product mindset and care about user impact

  • Are autonomous and pragmatic, comfortable navigating early-stage ambiguity and shipping fast

⚙️ Our tech stack

Our stack is designed to support AI-first workflows and production reliability.

  • Backend & Frontend: TypeScript, Node.js, React, tRPC

  • Infrastructure: AWS (Terraform)

  • Data & AI: Mastra, Bedrock

  • Database: Postgres

You don't need to master every tool — what matters is your ability to design robust systems, learn fast, and make sound technical trade-offs.

💎 What we offer

  • Build alongside a strong AI expert: Work closely with Alexandre, our CTO, who has deep expertise in AI agents, and turn cutting-edge AI into production systems.

  • Ownership & Impact: As the second engineering hire, you'll have real influence on the product and technical direction

  • Bring AI to real users: Build production AI systems that solve real problems in a complex, high-stakes domain

  • Hexa ecosystem: Access to expertise, resources, and network from one of Europe's leading startup studios

  • Competitive package: Attractive salary + meaningful equity

  • Paris-based team: Work alongside the founding team in our office

  • Growth: Opportunity to grow into a technical leadership role as the team scales

Plato is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

We know there's a long way to go regarding diversity in our industry, which is why we encourage all applicants to apply to our open positions.

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. description:

  • Gratification : 1 000 € par mois pour un stage de césure ou 1 200 € par mois pour un stage de fin d’études;

title: Administrateur Systèmes, Réseaux & Cloud (F/H)
description:
À propos de nous 
E-Finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans la gestion financière et la trésorerie. Nos solutions aident les entreprises à optimiser leurs flux financiers et à gagner en visibilité sur leur trésorerie. Nous les déployons en SaaS et en on-premise chez nos clients, avec de forts enjeux de sécurité et de disponibilité. 

Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. Dans une équipe à taille humaine, c’est le bon moment pour laisser une vraie empreinte. 

Le poste 
Rattaché(e) au responsable R&D et IT, vous êtes la personne de référence sur l’infrastructure et l’IT de l’entreprise. Vous partagez votre temps entre le quotidien et les sujets de fond. 

Au quotidien 

  • Gérer les arrivées et départs : postes, comptes, accès 
  • Gérer les accès et les échanges de fichiers sécurisés avec nos clients (SFTP, FTPS, listes blanches) 
  • Assurer l’assistance aux utilisateurs et appuyer le support sur les questions d’infrastructure de nos clients en on-premise 
  • Administrer Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, DNS et certificats 
  • Superviser les systèmes, gérer sauvegardes, mises à jour et patching 
  • Être l’interlocuteur du groupe pour les sujets Microsoft 365 et le relais auprès de nos prestataires IT 

Pour faire avancer l’entreprise 

  • Faire évoluer et optimiser nos environnements cloud et Microsoft (Azure, Entra ID) : sécurité, coûts, bonnes pratiques 
  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes et documenter l’existant 
  • Renforcer la sécurité : durcissement des postes et serveurs, suivi des vulnérabilités, réponse aux incidents 
  • Contribuer à la conformité (ISO 27001, RGPD), aux réponses aux questionnaires de sécurité et aux audits de nos clients 
  • Assurer une veille technologique et proposer des améliorations continues 

Votre profil 

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en administration systèmes et réseaux
  • Très bonne connaissance de Windows Server et d’Active Directory 
  • Connaissances Linux (Ubuntu et Debian) 
  • Connaissances en réseau 
  • Connaissances en virtualisation, supervision, sauvegarde et sécurité des systèmes d’information 
  • Notions d’Azure (paramétrage, administration courante) ou envie de monter en compétence sur le cloud public 
  • Connaissance de Microsoft 365 appréciée : son administration est assurée par le groupe, vous serez notre interlocuteur sur les besoins locaux 
  • Bases de scripting (PowerShell idéalement) 
  • Autonome : vous prenez les sujets en charge de bout en bout et vous tenez l’équipe informée de votre avancement 
  • Rigoureux(se) et capable d’expliquer simplement des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques 
  • Français courant, anglais technique lu et écrit 
  • Une certification (Azure AZ-104, Security+, ISO 27001) est un atout 

Ce que nous offrons 

  • Une équipe de 16 personnes dynamique avec une possibilité de prise de responsabilité 
  • Un poste à fort impact et visibilité au sein d’une équipe R&D et IT à taille humaine

description:

About the Role

Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

What you'll do

1. Cap Table & Share Register

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

  • Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

  • Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

  • Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

  • Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

  • Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

  • Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

  • Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

  • Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

The Technology Consulting business line is the technology and operations’ arm of the Novaspace group. It has more than 50 customers in developed and emerging space markets, in all regions of the world and across the space ecosystem, including satellite operators, governmental and international organizations (Space agencies, Defense agencies, regulatory bodies, etc.), financial institutions (private banks, commercial banks, private equity funds, etc.) and insurance brokers and insurance companies.
Novaspace Technology has developed expertise and know-how around a portfolio of services and capabilities covering the complete lifecycle of a space project, from feasibility studies and project development to operations and training support.
 
Novaspace Technology (formerly Satconsult), a leading satellite engineering consultancy firm, is looking for a talented Senior Remote Sensing Space Systems Technical Manager to join its growing team.
As Senior Remote Sensing Space Systems Technical Manager, you will be in charge of a large variety of activities to participate to our missions on Remote Sensing Space Systems.
For the defense and security purposes of our customers, you will participate to the definition or assessment of future Remote Sensing Systems:
· Electro-Optical (EO): MSI / HSI / VNIR, SWIR, TIR,
· Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR),
· Other remote sensing systems, e.g. ELINT, Lidar, etc.
 
Depending on our missions, you may be involved at different stage of a remote sensing project:
· Concept: performing analysis of innovative architecture or different trade-offs on remote sensing systems
· Feasibility: performing collection of user’s needs, generation and comparison of high-level preliminary designs, generation of high-level system requirements, system cost assessment and cost trade-offs.
· Procurement: performing generation/review of the ground system specifications (requirements for design, test, acceptance and operations) as part of the technical exhibit of an RFP, analysis and comparison of the different proposals received from the industry, final negotiation of the contract with the selected bidder(s).
· Construction: monitoring the execution of an industrial contract to design, build, integrate, test and commission a Remote Sensing Space Systems.
· Operations support/ training
· Technical Due Diligence
· etc
 
If this sounds like you, then read on!

Primary role and responsibilities
  • Lead or support engineering activities for remote sensing projects:
  • Understand and capture Customer needs,
  • Assess and identify the technologies necessary for the implementation of the system architecture,
  • Analyze ground system operations and contributes to the generation of the Concept Of Operations,
  • Review or generate requirements (e.g., Contractual Technical Annexes). and definition baselines of the overall system,
  • Analyze/review or perform the development, verification and validation of mission procedures,
  • Interface with customers for systems topics,
  • Prepare and participate to project reviews and workshops,
  • Participate to technical proposals and studies.

    • Desired skills & experience
  • Master’s degree in engineering, preferably in aerospace and remote sensing,
  • At least ten years of practical industry experience in Remote Sensing space instruments and/or systems
  • At least five years of experience of technical management of Remote Sensing space projects & teams in an international environment.

description:
Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d'utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs PRO dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L'entreprise propose des solutions complètes pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur envergure. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs dédiés à la protection contre les intrusions, à la vidéosurveillance, à la sécurité incendie, à la protection des personnes, ainsi qu'au confort et à l'automatisation. L'entreprise compte 5 000 collaborateurs.

Nous constituons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts du terrain sont les mieux placés pour appréhender les spécificités de chaque marché. L'entreprise est représentée commercialement dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud et dans de nombreuses autres régions.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d'Ajax Systems. L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication. Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.

L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax.

Ajax Systems est une success-story ukrainienne, portée par une force et une énergie hors du commun.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Network)
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
 

As a Site Reliability Engineer with strong networking skills in our Cloud Infrastructure (SRE) team, you help the team own the networks that keep Loft running: cloud networking, VPN and site-to-site connectivity, segmentation, and routing across our offices, test equipment, and ground stations. You keep them reliable, observable, and secure as we scale. You coordinate with IT on the network components that interface with the physical infrastructure used by employees. You coordinate with the Test-Infrastructure team to ensure our test equipment is securely accessible.

You’ll work the way an SRE team works: defining reliability in measurable terms (SLOs for connectivity and ground-station availability), instrumenting the systems that prove it, managing the network as code, and automating away toil so on-call load doesn’t grow with the fleet.

Beyond the network, you’ll help the SRE team across its broader scope by participating in all the daily work just like a regular SRE: platform reliability and expansion, incident response, planning and user support.


About this role:
  • Participate in the design and implement Loft’s network architecture; cloud networking, VPN/site-to-site, segmentation, and routing across offices, ground stations, and test equipment
  • Tighten the network security posture: segmentation, access, and connectivity hardening
  • Manage the network as code: IaC provisioning, CI/CD, and GitOps
  • Define SLOs for connectivity and ground-station availability, and own the observability (metrics, logs, tracing) that measures them; Grafana-centric stacks a plus
  • Investigate and resolve reliability issues with root-cause analysis and durable fixes; reduce operational toil through automation
  • Contribute to the SRE team’s broader reliability and incident-response work, fostering the SatDevOps culture that power Loft’s DNA

    • Must haves:
  • 4–5 years in network engineering, with deep hands-on networking: routing, VPN/site-to-site, segmentation, DNS, firewalling
  • Hands-on Software-Defined Networking: comfortable managing networks programmatically / as code rather than appliance-by-appliance (everything we run is IaC)
  • Strong public-cloud networking experience, ideally GCP (VPCs, peering, hybrid connectivity)
  • Comfortable operating on a Kuburnetes platform (k8s, Docker) and occasionally writing code
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar) and a CI/CD-driven, GitOps workflow
  • An SRE mindset: SLOs, observability, and reducing toil through automation
  • Ability to debug connectivity issues in a complex, hybrid network environment
  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

    • Nice to haves:
  • Network certifications (CCNP or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps frameworks (ArgoCD, FluxCD)

  • Understanding of orchestration in resource-constrained environments, like space systems

  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success

title: Product Manager
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.


About this role:
Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements
  • Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.
  • Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.
  • Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.
  • Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.
  • Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

    • Bring the outside in

    • Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.
    • Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.
    • Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

      • Decide and prioritize

      • Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.
      • Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.
      • Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.
      • Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

        • Communicate

        • Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.
        • Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.
        • Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

Must Haves:
  • 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management.
  • Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense.
  • Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology
  • Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.
  • Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.
  • Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.
  • High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan.
  • At ease being challenged, and challenging others, in a fast-moving and demanding environment.
  • Working knowledge of both hardware and software development lifecycles.
  • Proficient using and configuring Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence).
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel to other Loft offices and to customers.

Nice to Haves:
  • Fluency in French.
  • Experience with AI/ML products, edge computing, or developer and partner platforms and ecosystems.
  • Experience with satellite operations, constellation services, or ground segment products.
  • Exposure to institutional and defense customers and their procurement cycles.
  • Experience in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial NewSpace company or venture-backed deep-tech startup.

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Deployment & Runtime Environments
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the hub processor, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Deployment & Runtime Environments team is where software meets the satellite. We own how software gets packaged, deployed, and executed onboard: from the tool that assembles and maintains mission-specific software stacks, to the Runtime Container Environment that lets partner and customer workloads run securely in orbit, to the Linux infrastructure that makes it all reliable. As more satellite programs come online and as we open our container runtime to a growing number of external workloads, the team’s scope is expanding fast.

We’re looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who digs into an unfamiliar system, maps it out, and gets it shipped without needing the path handed to them. You’ll move between Linux internals, container runtimes, and CI pipelines, sometimes in the same afternoon.


About this role:
  • Contribute to and evolve our bundle management tool — the tool that resolves package dependencies, assembles mission-specific software stacks, and enables the Solutions team to spin up and maintain an ever-growing number of satellite programs
  • Develop and harden our onboard Linux infrastructure: how services are deployed on the rootfs, what system manages their execution, and how we ensure reliable and recoverable Linux operation in orbit
  • Evolve our Runtime Container Environment — the container manager and the full stack around it (base images, container registry service) — enabling partner and customer workloads to run securely onboard our vehicles
  • Support scaling of the deployment pipeline as new hardware platforms are added and the number of active satellite programs grows
  • Contribute to Product Validation — as the last step in the development pipeline, the team plays a key role in validating software readiness before it goes to orbit
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving features from concept through delivery
  • Participate in code reviews, design proposals, and the continuous improvement of development processes

Must Haves:
  • Strong understanding of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar runtimes)
  • Deep Linux system knowledge: boot process, service management, filesystem layout, and failure recovery
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar)
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with embedded or resource-constrained systems
  • Working Python

Nice to Haves:
  • Understanding of software deployment strategies for critical or hard-to-reach systems — OTA updates for cars, drones, or consumer hardware, or software updates on satellites — including concepts like golden images, A/B partitions, staged rollouts, and safe rollback
  • C++ knowledge
  • Experience with CUE (cuelang)
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages such as Go or Rust
  • Experience with embedded Linux: Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware frameworks (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Caen.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

title: Account Executive - Financial Services
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Le compte professionnel représente un enjeu central dans la stratégie de Pennylane :

  • Pour ses clients : Assurer le meilleur service possible en intégrant le compte professionnel directement dans leur outil de gestion/compta, assurant la possibilité de gérer l’entièreté de leur activité depuis 1 seul et même outil : Pennylane

  • Pour Pennylane : Faire grossir la part des Financial Services dans le revenu global de Pennylane.

C’est pourquoi nous créons une équipe dédiée sur ce périmètre.

🛣️ Mission et objectifs

👀 Vision

  • Transformer tous les utilisateurs en utilisateurs du compte pro Pennylane,

  • Faire des financial services un des principaux leviers de croissance de Pennylane.

Objectifs 2026

  • Part des Financial Services dans le revenu de Pennylane : x2,3

  • Nombre d’utilisateur de notre compte pro intégré ⇒ x1,9

2027

  • Part des Financial Services dans le revenu de Pennylane ⇒ x2 vs 2026

  • Nombre d’utilisateur de notre compte pro intégré ⇒ x2,3

2030 → Faire des financial services un des principaux leviers de croissance de Pennylane.

🫡 Mission

L’équipe AE Financial Services - SME a pour mission de transformer les TPEs (0-9 employés) clientes de Pennylane, en titulaires et utilisatrices d’un Compte Professionnel intégré à leur outil, leur permettant de gérer depuis Pennylane leurs achats (paiements fournisseurs, notes de frais, cartes bancaires, dépenses online) et vente (réception des paiements clients).

🎯 Objectif

L’équipe est objectivée sur le nombre de compte professionnels ouverts.

🖼️ Périmètre et responsabilités

Sales

Responsable de l’entièreté du cycle de vente

  • Identification des clients prioritaires ;

  • Contacting ;

  • Qualification ;

  • Closing.

Reporting

  • Documenter les actions dans Salesforce ;

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Financial Services, Marketing, Ops, Produit ;

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration du playbook (scripts, méthodologies …) et du funnel ;

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process.

  • Reporting.

⇒ En tant que création d’équipe, la capacité à identifier, remonter, optimiser, sera clé dans la réussite de la mission.

🫵 Profil recherché

  • Expérience en vente SDR, customer success/AM (avec forte appétence acquisition) ;

  • Goût pour les objectifs de conversion ;

  • Capacité à gérer un volume important de leads ;

  • Aisance au téléphone ;

  • Capacité à expliquer simplement un produit financier ;

  • Très bonne organisation ;

  • Rigueur CRM ;

  • capacité à travailler avec des équipes internes et des prestataires ;

  • capacité à identifier un blocage et à escalader au bon interlocuteur ;

title: Conversion Manager - Financial Services
description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Conversion Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Associate Director, Patient Advocacy, Skeletal Dysplasia
Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d)
description:
Als Mitglied der internationalen PureGym Gruppe mit mehr als 2 Millionen Mitgliedern gehören wir zu den drei größten Fitnessketten in Europa und sind damit bestens aufgestellt, um unsere ehrgeizigen Ziele weiter zu verfolgen und zu realisieren. So können wir in Zukunft einen noch grösseren und wichtigeren Beitrag zur Fitness und Gesundheit der Schweizer Bevölkerung leisten.


Für unser motiviertes Group Fitness Team in Lenzburg  suchen wir ab sofort eine leidenschaftliche und sportbegeisterte Person als Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d) unter anderem für die folgenden Kurse zu folgenden Zeiten:

BODYPUMP und ZUMBA.

Du möchtest lieber flexibel als Selbstständige/r arbeiten? Kein Problem – alternativ zur Festanstellung bieten wir dir auch eine freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit zu einem attraktiven höheren Stundenlohn an. Sprich uns gerne direkt darauf an. Für weitere Informationen hierzu wenden dich bitte direkt an die Studioleitung.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du leitest die Group Fitness Kurse und vermittelst dein Fachwissen mit grosser Begeisterung

  • Du bist für unsere Mitglieder da und betreust sie vor, während und nach deinen Kursen

  • Du bereitest deine Kurse vor, hältst die Gruppendynamik aufrecht und motivierst deine Teilnehmer:innen während des Kurses

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Sauberkeit und Hygieneregeln im Kursraum

  • Du kennst unsere Angebote und unsere Philosophie und kannst diese den Mitgliedern vermitteln

  • Du sorgst idealerweise selbstständig für deine Stellvertretungen und bist auch bereit bei Bedarf selbst als Stellvertretung einzuspringen


Was du mitbringst:

  • Du hast bereits fundierte Erfahrung als Groupfitness Instructor für die aufgeführten Kursarten und kannst Group Fitness Diplome oder nachweisbare Diplome im Bereich Zumba und Bodypump vorweisen

  • Du hast das Talent andere Menschen zu motivieren und sie mit jedem Training bei dir auf das nächste Level zu bringen

  • Du begeisterst unsere Mitglieder mit der Vielfalt deiner Trainingspalette und bringst in deinen Kursen sowohl Anfänger:innen als auch Fortgeschrittenen mit Spass an Bewegung zu ihren persönlichen Höchstleistungen

  • Du hast das Interesse und die Möglichkeit zukünftig mehrere Lektionen pro Woche an verschiedenen Wochentagen und/oder in verschiedenen Studios zu übernehmen

  • Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse


Was wir dir bieten:

title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    •  

    Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

  • Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

    •  

    API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    •  

    Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    •  

    Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

  • Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

    •  

    Key Personality Traits

  • Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

  • Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

  • Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
description:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

  • Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

  • Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

  • Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

  • Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

  • Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

  • Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

  • Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

  • Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

  • Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

  • Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

  • Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

  • Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

  • Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

  • E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

  • Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung.

Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um.

Lernen wir uns kennen

Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne.

Deine Ansprechpersonen:

  • Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen.

  • Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen.

Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt.

Dukers GmbH | St. Gallen

title: Autonomy Engineer Intern, Reinforcement Learning, 2027 (Zurich)
description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

Skydio builds the world’s most advanced autonomous drones used across inspection, public safety, defense, cinematography, and more. Your research won’t languish in a paper: it will fly, shaping how pilots and operators complete real missions in complex environments. Develop and deploy reinforcement learning (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft plan, navigate, and control themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Navigation & avoidance in the wild: Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking.

  • RL-augmented planning: Fuse learned cost shaping / value functions with trajectory optimization for smooth, agile flight with tight safety envelopes and mission constraints.

  • Sim to Real at scale: Build scalable datasets and training loops with Isaac Lab, domain randomization, residual learning, and safety filters; validate on real drones weekly.

  • Human-in-the-loop shared control: Learn assistive policies that blend pilot intent, autonomy priors, and uncertainty-aware behaviors for intuitive control handoffs.

  • Fleet & multi-agent: Explore decentralized coordination for coverage, pursuit, and collaborative mapping with minimal comms.

What makes this internship different:

  • Real hardware cadence: Prototype in sim, then flight test on production-ready aircraft and edge compute. Your work is meant to make a difference in the real world, not just in simulation.

  • Safety-first learning: We pair RL with formal constraints, estimation of uncertainty, and conservative action filters for dependable deployment in human environments.

  • Cross-disciplinary mentorship: Collaborate with perception, mapping, controls, and product teams to close the loop from research to field ops.

What makes you a strong fit:

  • PhD student in Robotics, Machine Learning, Controls, or related field.

  • Strong fundamentals in RL, control theory, and motion planning; comfort with safety/robustness concepts.

  • Proficient in Python (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of C++ or CUDA.

  • Hands-on experience with robotics simulation (Isaac Lab/MuJoCo/PyBullet) and sim2real techniques.

  • Experience training/deploying policies for navigation, manipulation, or locomotion on real robots or autonomous vehicles.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Publications (CoRL, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS).

  • Experience with onboard inference optimization (TensorRT, quantization, sparsity).

  • Familiarity with modern policy learning beyond vanilla RL: diffusion policies, IL/BC, offline RL, model-based RL.

  • Experience with multi-agent RL or distributed training.

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

 

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

 

What you'll do

  • Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

  • Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

  • Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

  • Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

  • Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

  • Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

  • Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

  • You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

  • You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

  • You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

  • You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

  • You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

  • You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

  • You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

 

Strong plus

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

  • Experience running multi-tenant systems.

  • Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

  • Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

  • Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
description:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant

Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.

Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

  • Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.
  • Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.
  • Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.
  • Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.
  • Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

  • Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.
  • Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons

Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.

Ce que nous cherchons
